title: Hourglass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- top and bottom caps -->
  <rect x='22' y='12' width='56' height='9' rx='4' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <rect x='22' y='79' width='56' height='9' rx='4' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <!-- cap highlights -->
  <rect x='25' y='13' width='50' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  <rect x='25' y='80' width='50' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  <!-- glass body -->
  <path d='M28,21 L72,21 C72,21 64,41 54,49 C52,50 52,50 54,51 C64,59 72,79 72,79 L28,79 C28,79 36,59 46,51 C48,50 48,50 46,49 C36,41 28,21 28,21 Z' fill='#8ECAE6' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- top sand -->
  <path d='M32,24 L68,24 C68,24 62,40 53,47 L47,47 C38,40 32,24 32,24 Z' fill='#F4A261'/>
  <!-- top sand highlight -->
  <path d='M36,26 L64,26 C64,26 59,38 52,44 L48,44 C41,38 36,26 36,26 Z' fill='#FFB77A' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- falling sand stream -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='47' width='3' height='18' rx='1.5' fill='#F4A261'/>
  <!-- falling sand sparkle -->
  <rect x='49' y='50' width='2' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <!-- bottom sand pile -->
  <path d='M34,77 L66,77 C66,77 63,62 54,57 L46,57 C37,62 34,77 34,77 Z' fill='#F4A261'/>
  <!-- bottom sand highlight -->
  <path d='M38,75 L62,75 C62,75 59,64 53,60 L47,60 C41,64 38,75 38,75 Z' fill='#FFB77A' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- glass side lights -->
  <path d='M30,24 C32,38 38,46 45,49' stroke='#D4EEF7' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M30,76 C32,62 38,54 45,51' stroke='#D4EEF7' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- left wooden post -->
  <rect x='24' y='20' width='4' height='60' rx='2' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <!-- right wooden post -->
  <rect x='72' y='20' width='4' height='60' rx='2' fill='#B5651D'/>
  <!-- post highlights -->
  <rect x='25' y='22' width='1.5' height='56' rx='0.75' fill='#E8A050' opacity='0.7'/>
  <rect x='73' y='22' width='1.5' height='56' rx='0.75' fill='#E8A050' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- cute faces on caps -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='16.5' r='1.5' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='16.5' r='1.5' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='83.5' r='1.5' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='83.5' r='1.5' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
</svg>
